item.tib: gangs can mkhas pa'i skyabs mgon ston pa rje / 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan rin chen 'od stong 'bar / mun pa'i tsha zer mdo gzungs don rnams bsdus / lhag pa'i snying po gzungs mchog dam pa
item.note: this section ends with a gzungs concerning the evils of beer. this final text is a gter ma of khye'u gnyan-thang (i.e. gnyan-mthing).
